notes:
- Quick notes from calls and threads:
- Product: Elmbridge builds an embedded customer chat widget for mid-market SaaS (payments, billing, order support).
- Primary need: streaming-first UX with tool-calling so agent bot can call internal APIs (order status, refunds).
- Latency SLO: target <1.5s first-token in US region; target 95th percentile at scale.
- Throughput: expected steady-state 50-150 reqs/s depending on campaign; concurrency up to 200 agents during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market buyer — willing to commit if unit economics are predictable; open to Dedicated if pricing locked and uptime SLA.
- Model prefs: prefer open models or Redwood-verified smaller variants for cost; need fallback policy (cheaper model) on capacity constraints.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs mandatory; KMS for encryption; legal wants EU residency option for EMEA customers.
- POC notes: streaming tokens provided by Redwood; initial harness run showed median first-token ~0.9s, 95th ~1.7s under synthetic load. Ops suggested KV cache priming and smaller minibatches to hit 95th <1.5s.
- Quote from Head of Product: "Streaming must feel instant — otherwise customers drop out of the widget."
- Internal friction: procurement asking for on-prem contingency; commercial wants 12-month committed pricing for Dedicated.
- Next: 72h POC with adjusted batching + re-run benchmark; schedule finance pricing deep-dive (w/ cost model) week of 2026-03-15.
